newsitem.title: USA: Berg Electronics Q4 net up on lower costs.
newsitem.headline: Berg Electronics Q4 net up on lower costs.

text.p: Berg Electronics said Tuesday it posted record net income in the fourth quarter thanks in part to cost containment and cost reduction measures.

The company reported earnings of $9.2 million in the period ended December 31, up from a loss of $3.8 million. Berg Electronics said the year-ago figure included preferred stock charges of about $3.8 million.
Sales in the latest period reached $173.9 million versus $171.7 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Berg Electronics makes connectors and cable assembly products. Its shares were up 1-3/8 Tuesday at 30-5/8.
